# Overview

This mod is distributed as `.modpkg` which contains all skins of Penny as well.

## Features:
- Custom Animations
- Custom VFX
- Custom Model (Brawl Stars)
- Custom Icons

### How to activate other skins

- When you install the skin on Celestial, click on the layers icon and select the skin you want to play with, otherwise you play with default Penny.
- Only 1 works at a time!
